subject: Phase 1 checkpoint: integration tests + manual demo
description:
Execute the Phase 1 checkpoint gate per §9.1.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] All Phase 1 unit + integration tests pass.
- [ ] Manual demo: user texts "hi" via AMC; Capo replies. Webhook handler responds in < 1s (verified in Logfire trace).
- [ ] HMAC signature mismatch returns 401 and never reaches dispatcher (asserted by integration test).
- [ ] Duplicate `X-AMC-Delivery-Id` is deduped (integration test).
- [ ] Restart with unread messages → all unread arrive at agent exactly once.
- [ ] Pydantic Settings boot-time validation rejects a `.env` missing `AMC_WEBHOOK_SECRET` with clear error.
- [ ] Spec checklist for §5.1, §5.2, §5.7 (basic), §5.11 signed off in `internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md` change log.

_Performance:_
- [ ] Webhook P99 < 1s under 1000 synthetic signed requests at 5 rps.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Smoke: end-to-end echo path against real AMC + cheap Anthropic model
• Integration: restart-with-unread test
• Integration: HMAC mismatch test
• Integration: dedupe test
• Performance: 1000 signed webhooks at 5 rps (assert P99 < 1s)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Section 9.1 (Checkpoint Gate)
